decision: All 21 part scans prepped with --like car6.json (no re-normalisation); registration verified by red-over-grey renders and nearest-surface distance
why: Outer panels sit 1.6-5 mm median from the full car with mean offsets <=2 mm (hood 1.6, rear bumper 2.1, fenders 2.4-3.1); Artec states share one frame, so exploded parts will seat exactly

decision: Reference video not watched; worked from training/references/README.md Temerario notes
why: Dropbox links are served from a random uc*.dl.dropboxusercontent.com host per link; one host was allowed but the next link came from a different host, and wildcards can only be added in Settings

decision: Original procedural score (tools/music.py + cues.json), 100 BPM D minor: sub, soft pads, restrained kick/hats, riser 23.4-26.4 into the explode, impact at 26.4 (separation), big impact at 32.4 (reassembly lock), Dm chord + hall tail under the logo
why: User (relayed by the coordinating session): generate music that matches the beat instead of using a Dropbox track. 100 BPM makes a bar 2.4 s = 72 frames, so every cut sits on a bar line and hits land exactly on cuts and motion keys; waveform check: hits within 1-10 ms of each cut

decision: Structure: front 3/4 turntable (2 bars) -> rear 3/4 orbit (2) -> front wheel/brake ECU (1) -> nose/lamp detail (1) -> hood opens (2) -> engine cover opens (1) -> rear-high to top-down (2) -> exploded view separate/hold/reassemble (3) -> logo (2); 16 bars = 38.4 s
why: Brief: Temerario order (turntables, extreme close-ups, hood/engine open, top-down, exploded, logo), 30-40 s; bar-length shots keep every cut on the 100 BPM grid

decision: Detail shot is the front lamp/intake, not the tail lamps
why: Tail-lamp lenses are scan holes (dark blotches at close range); never feature hero areas with holes

decision: Hood opens 58 deg on its rear hinge over comp_hood (full car minus hood skin + frunk from 'Front Fully Removed', cropped below z 120 mm raw to drop the propped-open hood captured in that scan)
why: The 296 front lid hinges at the windscreen (seen in the Front Fully Removed scan); state scan as captured over the trimmed full car per lessons

decision: Engine cover (louvred lid) opens 85 deg about its front edge over comp_engine (+ Engine Bay scan)
why: Only the louvre lid exists as a part scan; near-vertical is the angle where the opening reads from a high rear 3/4

decision: Exploded view: hood, front bumper (outer+inner), right front fender, right side skirt, engine cover, rear bumper (outer+inner), diffuser (outer+inner) over comp_explode; separate 26.4 s (ease-out, on the impact), slow drift, fly home ease-in to LOCK at 32.4 s
why: All parts verified registered; ease-in return makes them slam home exactly on the big impact; right-side parts only because only right fender/skirt were scanned; parts pushed down/back so nothing flies at the lens

decision: Framing tightened after the first 30% preview (orbit radius 7.4 -> 5.3 m, top-down from 10.6 -> 6.9 m, explode 8.6 -> 7.5 m)
